description: This file defines the 'EagerSession' class in the TensorFlow Java API. It manages eager execution environments, including configuration options, resource management, and lifecycle controls within the TensorFlow framework.

classes.name: EagerSession
classes.description: Manages an eager execution environment for TensorFlow operations, providing configuration, resource management, and lifecycle controls.

classes.name: EagerSession.Options
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration options for creating 'EagerSession' instances.

classes.name: EagerSession.NativeReference
classes.description: Abstract class for references to native resources managed by 'EagerSession'.

classes.name: EagerSession.NativeResourceCollector
classes.description: Manages the collection and cleanup of native resource references associated with an 'EagerSession'.

methods.name: opBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for a TensorFlow operation, with the session checked for validity.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, releasing native resources and stopping background cleanup thread if applicable.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton default eager session, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initDefault
methods.description: Initializes the default eager session with specified options, throws if already initialized.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new eager session with default options.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns a new options object for configuring an 'EagerSession'.
